generated_assets.prompt: Create a production sprite animation atlas based STRICTLY on the provided pet character sheet. Preserve these exact four characters' face shapes, proportions, markings, warm colors, dark chocolate pixel outlines, glossy black eyes and crisp chunky pixel-art shading. Do not simplify or redesign. Transparent RGBA background, no text, no grid lines, no ground or shadows. Layout EXACTLY six equal columns and four equal rows, 1536x1024 canvas, each cell 256x256. Each character remains entirely within its cell with generous 16px minimum margins. SAME character scale and SAME baseline y=232 in EVERY cell. Row 1 only orange-white cat from reference, Row 2 only orange-white floppy eared dog, Row 3 only pale green cute snake, Row 4 only gray-brown raccoon. Every pose faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view exactly like walking column of reference. Six columns are SIX CONSECUTIVE ANIMATION FRAMES of a natural WALK CYCLE (not six identical poses): contact, down, passing, opposite contact, down, passing. Cat/dog/raccoon front and rear legs alternate clearly with paw lift and planted paws, subtle ear and tail follow-through; maintain body/head size unchanged. Snake six frames have a smooth S-shaped traveling body ripple, stable head, occasional tiny tongue flick. No turning, no sitting, no jumping. This is an animation atlas intended for direct 6-column 4-row runtime cropping. Most important: visibly different leg positions across six frames while remaining the EXACT cute detailed pixel characters in the supplied image.
